title: SAT Quashes MCX's Rs 1.49 Crore Penalty on Ventura Securities, Orders Refund With Costs
case_name: Ventura Securities Ltd. v. Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd.
citation: Appeal No. 363 of 2026 with MA Nos. 1073 and 1079 of 2026; 2026 LLBiz SAT 37, decided 26 October 2026
card_summary: The Securities Appellate Tribunal quashed a Rs 1.49 crore penalty MCX had imposed on Ventura Securities over a client crossing the 2 per cent open position limit in natural gas options. The disciplinary order's signatory had already left the committee, and a SEBI circular capped such penalties at Rs 2 lakh; MCX did not contest either point. The tribunal ordered an immediate refund, with Rs 1 lakh costs against MCX.
card_tip: A disciplinary order signed after the signatory has demitted office is vulnerable on that ground alone; check the committee's composition on the date of the order, not the date of the breach.
verification_notes: Confirmed by three independent reports (Bar and Bench, LiveLawBiz, LawChakra) agreeing on the amount, date, grounds and relief; SEBI order itself not accessed.
